title: Submitting RELION GPU Jobs to Comet at SDSC
author: Michael Cianfrocco
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i3ecgje

steps.title: Log into Comet
steps.instruction: Access the Comet cluster using a terminal.

substeps.instruction: Enter your XSEDE username and password

steps.title: Prepare Project Directory
steps.instruction: Navigate to your Oasis storage and create a directory for the dataset.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to storage: cd /oasis/projects/nsf/[XSEDE allocation ID]/[username]
Create a new project directory: mkdir mysample

steps.title: Transfer Data
steps.instruction: Move datasets from your local machine to the Oasis storage directory.

substeps.instruction: Use globus.org for easy transfer, or use scp or rsync from the command line

steps.title: Generate RELION Command
steps.instruction: Use the RELION GUI to obtain the specific job command.

substeps.instruction: Open the RELION GUI using the command: relion
Input job parameters and select 'Print command'
Copy the output text following the command relion_refine or relion_refine_mpi

steps.title: Create Submission Script
steps.instruction: Create a bash script using 'vi' incorporating the SLURM template and the RELION command.

substeps.instruction: Include the following SBATCH headers: #!/bin/bash, #SBATCH --job-name='reliongpu', #SBATCH --output='reliongpu.%j.%N.out', #SBATCH --partition=gpu, #SBATCH --nodes=1, #SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=24, #SBATCH --no-requeue, #SBATCH --gres=gpu:4, #SBATCH -t 2:00:00 (edit for time), #SBATCH --mail-type=begin,end, #SBATCH --mail-user=[email], #SBTACH --export=ALL, #SBATCH -A [XSEDE Project ID]
Load the module: module load relion/2.0.3
Add the execution command: ibrun -np 5 --tpr 4 relion_refine_mpi [paste relion command here]
